mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_risk_alert WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_type = 'CONSUMABLE' AND business_id = #{id} AND risk_code = 'CONSUMABLE_LOW_STOCK' AND risk_status IN ('OPEN', 'HANDLING', 'IGNORED') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_purchase_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND item.consumable_id = #{id} AND item.received_quantity <> COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ledger.quantity) FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND ledger.source_item_id = item.id), 0)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_consumable_request_item item WHERE item.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND item.consumable_id = #{id} AND (item.issued_quantity <> COALESCE((SELECT -SUM(ledger.quantity) FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'CONSUMABLE_REQUEST' AND ledger.source_item_id = item.item_id AND ledger.transaction_type = 'OUTBOUND'), 0) OR item.returned_quantity <> COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ledger.quantity) FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'CONSUMABLE_REQUEST' AND ledger.source_item_id = item.item_id AND ledger.transaction_type = 'RETURN'), 0) OR item.issued_amount <> COALESCE((SELECT -SUM(ledger.amount) FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'CONSUMABLE_REQUEST' AND ledger.source_item_id = item.item_id AND ledger.transaction_type = 'OUTBOUND'), 0.00) OR item.returned_amount <> COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ledger.amount) FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'CONSUMABLE_REQUEST' AND ledger.source_item_id = item.item_id AND ledger.transaction_type = 'RETURN'), 0.00))) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_asset_log history WHERE history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND history.ref_type = '2' AND history.ref_id = #{id} AND history.quantity_change <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = history.tenant_id AND ledger.asset_log_id = history.log_id)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_purchase_receipt receipt WHERE receipt.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receipt.consumable_id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_ledger ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = receipt.tenant_id AND ledger.source_biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND ledger.source_biz_id = receipt.id AND ledger.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NULL)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_consumable_request request WHERE request.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_request_item target WHERE target.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND target.request_id = request.request_id AND target.consumable_id = #{id}) AND (request.issued_amount <> COALESCE((SELECT SUM(detail.issued_amount) FROM oa_consumable_request_item detail WHERE detail.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND detail.request_id = request.request_id), 0.00) OR request.returned_amount <> COALESCE((SELECT SUM(detail.returned_amount) FROM oa_consumable_request_item detail WHERE detail.tenant_id = request.tenant_id AND detail.request_id = request.request_id), 0.00)))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role role ON role.role_id = membership.role_id AND role.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role.status = '0' AND role.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu permission ON permission.role_id = role.role_id AND permission.tenant_id = role.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = permission.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.user_id = #{userId} AND menu.perms IN (#{permission}, '*:*:*')
